title: Meet the Academics Trying to Stop You From Having Sex in Robotaxis
summary: They don’t want people to have sex in self-driving cars because they’re worried it will give a potentially positive technology a really bad rep. “We want to see automated mobility solutions accepted, trusted by the general public,” Rouchitsas says.
